title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Find pages and reports with advanced Tell Me search (AI-powered feature)
summary: Advanced Tell Me search in Business Central 2025 wave 2 uses AI and semantic meaning to help users find pages and reports without remembering exact names, reducing search time and improving productivity. The feature is in public preview, available only for online, and must be manually enabled in Feature Management.
key_points: AI-powered semantic search goes beyond exact text matching to find relevant pages and reports
New Advanced tab appears in Tell Me after enabling the feature in Feature Management
Feature is currently available only for Business Central online
Users must sign out and back in for changes to take effect
Some localization issues reported with language packs affecting search functionality

quotes.text: This AI-powered feature helps you quickly locate any page or report, even when you don't remember the exact name.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the core value of the feature in reducing user frustration and search time

quotes.text: This feature adds an advanced search option in Tell Me that finds results based on semantic meaning, not just exact text matches.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key technical difference between standard and advanced search capabilities

quotes.text: This feature is available only for Business Central online.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important limitation for users to understand deployment scope
